verdict: Yes, for a founder who understands the buyer. Forever Modest pitched premium modest clothing for Muslim women on Shark Tank India Season 2 and won a deal with four sharks. It's an underserved market with loyal customers and strong word of mouth, including buyers in the Gulf.
angle: Many women want modest clothing that is also stylish, and mainstream brands rarely design for them. Abayas, long dresses and co-ords with full coverage sell well through Instagram and WhatsApp communities. Community trust matters more than ads, so work with creators your buyers already follow.
